confidence_notes: Dining estimates are informed by [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Orlando/); prices for July may differ. Cocktail and wine estimates use beer-relative pricing and [Orlando happy-hour comparisons](https://daddyshappyhour.com/florida/happy-hour-prices). Accommodation is modeled, with hostel prices especially uncertain due to limited supply. Dining prices exclude tax and tips.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates reflect Orlando's tourism demand and general price levels in Florida destinations such as Tampa.
